fields.Name: Nano Banana 2.1
fields.Description: Google's Gemini image generation and editing model gemini-nano-banana-2.1, an update to Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image). Generates at 1K, 2K and 4K. Pricing on the Gemini API is token-based: $1.50 per million input tokens (text, image or video), $7.50 per million text and thinking output tokens, and $30 per million image output tokens, which Google prices per image at $0.0336 (1K), $0.0504 (2K) and $0.113 (4K). No free tier.

fields.UnitTypeID: @lookup:MJ: AI Model Price Unit Types.Name=Per Image
fields.Comments: gemini-nano-banana-2.1 on the Gemini API (standard tier), as published 2026-10-13: $0.0336 per 1K image, $0.0504 per 2K, $0.113 per 4K (image output $30 per 1M tokens). Input $1.50 per 1M tokens and text/thinking output $7.50 per 1M tokens are billed in addition. Batch: $0.0168 / $0.0252 / $0.0567 per image. This row records the 1K rate. Source: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing
